card.name: Linking marks inside drug and topic lists
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and', 'of' or 'with' right after a drug or condition name in a list, mostly anticonvulsants such as phenytoin or phenobarbital, just before the next item is named.

modes.label: Comma after anticonvulsant
modes.description: A comma or 'and' follows an enzyme-inducing or seizure drug in an interaction list.

modes.label: Seizure or condition list
modes.description: A comma or 'with' follows a seizure or epilepsy term in a description.

modes.label: Doctrine of God
modes.description: 'of' after the word doctrine in religious text.
modes.example: But the new doctrine<< of>> God renders that idea meaningless.

card.plain: It fires on the small joining mark after a drug name, such as phenytoin, when another drug is about to be listed.
